description: "Use when: changing user interfaces, HTML semantics, interaction patterns, or responsive styles"

# Accessibility

- Make accessibility a priority so people with different disabilities can use the interface.
  - Especially for Deaf users:
  - Enable Sign Language recording whenever possible, for example with [Videomail](https://videomail.io) or its [Wordpress integration](https://wordpress.org/plugins/videomail-for-ninja-forms/).
  - Provide captions or transcripts for audio content and ensure visual cues are clear and informative.
- Avoid unnecessary dialogs, especially on mobile.
- When a dialog is necessary, use correct semantics, manage focus, support keyboard use and provide a clear way to dismiss it.
